items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: A zero-day vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers remote code execution, actively exploited in the wild. Adobe released an emergency hotfix on September 7, 2026, following Sansec's discovery on September 5, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A regularly scheduled security update resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Account Takeover
items.summary: A critical Incorrect Authorization flaw in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source enabling unauthenticated elevated access, leading to customer session switch and account takeover. It was fixed in APSB26-92 and added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on September 24, 2026, due to active exploitation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A regularly scheduled security update resolving critical and important vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. This bulletin includes CVE-2026-71362.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A security update resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: SessionReaper: Unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to gain full control of a store through session takeover and in some cases remote code execution. Automated attacks have been observed as recently as September 8, 2026, though a patch was released in September 2025.

items.title: PolyShell vulnerability in Magento's REST API
items.summary: A new critical vulnerability in Magento's REST API that allows attackers to upload fake image files containing executable code, leading to remote code execution. No official fix was available at the time of reporting in March 2026.
